article.chapter: Norma, estilo y elección avanzada C2 — 규범·문체·C2 고급 선택

claims.summary: The National Institute of Korean Language guide describes -습니다 as characteristic of formal speech and -요 as characteristic of informal speech.

The guide says speech level depends partly on whether a situation is official or not and expects honorific speech in formal situations such as broadcasts, lectures, and public speaking, even among close friends.
The entry’s editing procedure uses addressee and situation to review speech-level endings; this is an editorial application of the guide, not a claim that all sentences or genres require one ending.

locator.section: Chapter 12, “Polite Korean Language,” printed pp. 90–93 / PDF pp. 49–51; web lines 817–830

links.notes: The passage directly contrasts -습니다/-요 and states the role of situation and formal public contexts; editorial application is explicitly scoped.
